area.arrivalHint: The warded doorway, inner room and back stair offer two ways through the house.

regions.label: Writing desk
regions.observation: Ordinary copying work, a few books, and an ink-stained sheet.

regions.label: Sleeping room
regions.observation: A narrow bed and a packed chest. The second door has fittings for an inside bar.

regions.label: Warded threshold
regions.observation: The ward is worked into the threshold. It holds only when the door is closed from within.
